coverage.surface: Outdoors Events discovery: edge function contract, ledger schema, client, all three screen generations
coverage.note: Read the function, both migrations, the client and the three consoles in full; compared the function with f6416124. Confirmed fixed since the 2026-11-04 handoff: completed_at (not finished_at) is written and read; malformed/empty/unknown-action bodies return 400 before any paid call; run_one validates the caller's JWT and workspace membership before service-role writes; run_all requires the service-role token; refresh updates only discovery columns so operator status/notes/tags/name survive; a concurrent insert (23505) refreshes the winning row; a failed spend lookup stops the run; 'paused' is returned without a ledger row (the status check constraint has no 'paused' value, so not writing one is correct). discovery-function.test.ts executes the real handler with doubles and covers each of those. coverage.surface: Edge-function HTTP contracts: authentication, CORS, request/response and error bodies for all eight functions, and how each is deployed and scheduled
